name: Komiflo
summary: Japan's premier legal flat-rate adult manga streaming service—partnering directly with Wanimagazine (Kairakuten/X-Eros) & Core Magazine for day-one uncut magazines.
ranking_rationale: Official Netflix-style flat monthly pass for Japan's top commercial H-manga magazines on release day (trade-off: Japanese language manga & UI — no English translations—use Fakku for English).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
